assessment.title: Cognitive Assessment
assessment.subtitle: Complete the following tests to evaluate your cognitive profile

cpt.title: Continuous Performance Test
cpt.description: Measures sustained attention and impulse control. Press only when you see the target letter.
cpt.instruction: Press the button ONLY when you see the letter 'X'. Do NOT press for any other letter.

stroop.title: Stroop Color-Word Test
stroop.description: Measures cognitive flexibility and inhibition. Select the INK COLOR, not the word.
stroop.instruction: Select the COLOR of the ink, not the word itself.

corsi.title: Corsi Block Tapping
corsi.description: Measures visuospatial working memory. Repeat the sequence by tapping blocks in order.
corsi.instruction: Watch the blocks light up, then tap them in the SAME order.
corsi.yourTurn: Your turn! Tap the blocks in order.

reaction.title: Reaction Time Test
reaction.description: Measures processing speed. Tap as quickly as possible when the circle turns green.
reaction.instruction: Wait for the circle to turn GREEN, then tap as fast as you can.

nback.title: N-Back Test
nback.description: Measures working memory capacity. Identify when the current shape matches N steps back.
nback.instruction: Press 'Match' if the current shape is the same as the one shown N steps ago.

adhd.title: ADHD Screener (ASRS v1.1)
adhd.description: A validated screening questionnaire for attention and hyperactivity symptoms.
adhd.disclaimer: This is a screening tool, not a clinical diagnosis. Please consult a healthcare professional.
adhd.q1: How often do you have difficulty wrapping up the final details of a project, once the challenging parts have been done?
adhd.q2: How often do you have difficulty getting things in order when you have to do a task that requires organization?
adhd.q3: How often do you have problems remembering appointments or obligations?
adhd.q4: When you have a task that requires a lot of thought, how often do you avoid or delay getting started?
adhd.q5: How often do you fidget or squirm with your hands or feet when you have to sit down for a long time?
adhd.q6: How often do you feel overly active and compelled to do things, like you were driven by a motor?
adhd.resultLow: Your responses suggest low risk for attention/hyperactivity difficulties.
adhd.resultModerate: Your responses suggest moderate risk. Consider discussing these results with a healthcare provider.
adhd.resultHigh: Your responses suggest elevated risk. We recommend consulting a healthcare professional for further evaluation.
